# aiflow

> aiflow turns any repository into a governed, AI-driven software-delivery pipeline — agent-agnostic
> across Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex CLI via a shared AGENTS.md — with durable
> Beads task memory, a code knowledge graph (graphify) plus semantic RAG (cocoindex-code), context7
> live docs, specialist agents and auto-offered Skills, gitflow branching + release automation
> (predefined release workflows for GitHub/GitLab/Gitea/Forgejo/Bitbucket), Ollama local models,
> model routing, team collaboration over a shared Dolt issue graph, and token savings via caveman
> and rtk. One command, project-scoped, vendor-neutral, MIT-licensed. Owner: Cyber93de.
